descriptions.rgb: Across the five frames, a woman in a green sari stands about 1–2 m in front of the camera wearer, initially left of center and partly cut off above the shoulders, then shifts toward the center-right and becomes visible from head to feet. Wooden posts stand vertically between the foreground and the shaded structure, intermittently occluding parts of the woman and background; a seated or crouching person in light blue is about 3–4 m ahead near the building, facing mostly away or sideways and not looking toward the camera. Another smaller, partly occluded figure in red is approximately 4–5 m ahead near a large basket, behind and to the right of the seated person. Over time the camera wearer’s hands rise into the lower-right foreground and extend toward the woman as she turns toward and looks at the wearer, leans or steps closer, and reaches down until their hands are within contact distance in the final frame.
